python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0020:
# Sofa is to the right!
# Let check obs_0001, obs_0003, obs_0004 for sofa!
for name in ["obs_0001", "obs_0002", "obs_0003", "obs_0004", "obs_0005", "obs_0006", "obs_0007"]:
    arr = np.array(Image.open(f"/work/observations/{name}.png"))
    sofa_m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 90) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 140) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 150) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 120) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 170)
    y, x = np.where(sofa_m)
    if len(x) > 50:
        print(f"Sofa in {name}: x=[{x.min()}, {x.max()}], mean x={x.mean():.1f}, y=[{y.min()}, {y.max()}]")
'
input.description: Search for sofa in initial 360 degree spin
